informationToProvide.label: Accommodation Type, Room Count & Target Star Rating
Public Liability Insurance Policy Confirmation
informationToProvide.aiHint: Insurance schedule showing public liability cover for guests.

informationToProvide.label: Certificate of Acceptability (CoA) (if meals served)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Municipal health certificate if breakfast or dining is provided.

informationToProvide.label: Company CoR 14.3, SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN & B-BBEE Sworn Affidavit (For TGCSA Grading Subsidy)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your CoR 14.3, SARS TCS PIN letter, and B-BBEE Sworn Affidavit to qualify for the Department of Tourism / TGCSA grading fee discount.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3, valid SARS TCS PIN letter, and B-BBEE Affidavit/Certificate in the hospitality entity name.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Lawful Occupation (Title Deed / Lease) & Interior/Exterior Establishment Photographs
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your property lease/title deed and photos of the establishment exterior, bedrooms, bathrooms, and dining/common areas.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Property lease agreement or title deed plus photographs of the hospitality establishment.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect property inventory, insurance, and compliance documents
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Inventory, photos, insurance, and subsidy criteria checked

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare TGCSA application and subsidy discount bundle
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Online application drafted with discount subsidy documentation

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver TGCSA submission dossier & assessor prep checklist
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Delivered to client for assessor booking
